description: This file defines a template interface IIteratorType within the WPEFramework::RPC namespace. The interface describes an iterator pattern with methods for traversing and accessing elements of type ELEMENT, and is parameterized by an interface ID. It is designed to be inherited by concrete iterator implementations.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A templated interface for an iterator over elements of type ELEMENT. Provides methods for iteration control (Next, Previous, Reset), validation (IsValid), size (Count), and current element retrieval (Current). It inherits from Core::IUnknown for base interface functionalities.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element and outputs it through the info parameter. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element and outputs it through the info parameter. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator position to the specified index.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements available through the iterator.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.
